about.title: About Me
paragraph: I’m Fabio Andrés, a frontend developer focused on building user-centered solutions.

My journey with code began at 16 and took an unconventional path through technical support and YouTube content creation. That experience broadened my perspective and strengthened my ability to understand real-world problems and communicate ideas clearly.
Today, I apply all of that learning to building functional and intuitive software, writing clean, efficient code aimed at solving real user needs.
